name: Floe
description: Broken plates of ice on dark water, larger and smaller with a smooth field and all turned a little with the drift, like pack ice breaking up.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(polygon(8% 14%, 70% 2%, 98% 40%, 84% 94%, 18% 86%), polygon(2% 30%, 46% 4%, 96% 18%, 90% 78%, 40% 98%, 6% 74%), polygon(14% 4%, 92% 10%, 96% 66%, 60% 96%, 4% 82%)); clip-path: @pick(polygon(8% 14%, 70% 2%, 98% 40%, 84% 94%, 18% 86%), polygon(2% 30%, 46% 4%, 96% 18%, 90% 78%, 40% 98%, 6% 74%), polygon(14% 4%, 92% 10%, 96% 66%, 60% 96%, 4% 82%)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@rn(-70, 70, 1.3)deg) scale(@calc(max(0.35, min(1.08, @rn(0.05, 1.4, 1.2))))); transform: rotate(@rn(-70, 70, 1.3)deg) scale(@calc(max(0.35, min(1.08, @rn(0.05, 1.4, 1.2))))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
